actions.action: Move plant into direct morning sun for a set time, then back to bright shade, lifting by the pot rim
Increase morning sun exposure by 1 hour every 3-4 days until 4-6 hours
In hot summers, shade the plant during strong afternoon sun
Inspect sun-facing beads for bleached, tan or brown sunburn patches
If sunburn appears, go back to the previous sun duration for a few days
Check soil moisture 2 inches deep before watering
Water thoroughly when soil is completely dry and ensure drainage
